text.p: Quarter Ended June 30, Six Months Ended June 30,
Note: (1) Net income per share is based on net income divided by the weighted average number of common and common equivalent shares outstanding during the period.

For the 1996 periods, net income per share is calculated based on historical net income and assuming the Company's initial public offering and related debt transactions that occurred during October 1996 had occurred as of the beginning of the reporting period.

(2) The Company recorded a provision for income taxes (principally alternative minimum tax) of $0.5 million and $2.5 million for the quarter and six month period ended June 30, 1997, respectively, and no provision for income taxes for the quarter and six month period ended June 30, 1996, principally as a result of utilization of net operating loss carryforwards.

On a pro forma basis, assuming an effective tax rate of 37.5%, the Company earnings per share would have been $.32 and $.07 for the quarters ended June 30, 1997 and 1996, respectively, and $.65 and $.12 for the six months ended June 30, 1997 and 1996, respectively.

(3) In compliance with FAS109 "Accounting for Income Taxes," and assuming operating trends continue, the Company is anticipating the release of its deferred tax valuation allowance in the third quarter 1997. This would result in a one-time, non-cash gain of approximately $65.0 million in reported earnings for the third quarter.
In the fourth quarter of 1997, the Company would begin reporting book income taxes with an expected effective tax rate of approximately 37.5%.
($ in millions, except per share data)
Note: Full company name is Gulfstream Aerospace Corp.
